TC1_checkpoint_training_provenance.details: All 3 checkpoints (strategy_a, strategy_b, strategy_c) have complete training runs, fit logs, results.csv (30 epochs), args.yaml, and training_receipt.json.

TC2_checkpoint_sha256_match.details: Exported handoff checkpoints match training output fit/weights/best.pt bit-for-bit with 0 mismatch.

TC3_csv_matches_json.details: Zero discrepancies between runs/benchmarks/week5_domain_adaptation/final_gpu_handoff/comparison.csv and comparison.json across all 25 columns and 4 rows.

TC4_identical_eval_datasets.details: Validation datasets across all runs are bit-for-bit identical (VN Val: 201 images, 201 labels; D-Fire Val: 2547 images, 2547 labels; 0 differences).

TC5_replay_ratio_20_percent.details: Replay selection contains exactly 147 D-Fire train images mixed with 585 VN train images, resulting in actual_replay_fraction = 147 / (585 + 147) = 20.08197% (delta from 0.20 is +0.08%). 0 images overlap with D-Fire Val or VN.

TC6_video_leakage_and_split_overlap.details: VN Train (61 videos) and VN Val (23 videos) have 0 video overlap, 0 scene group overlap, 0 image hash overlap.

TC7_consistent_class_mapping.details: All checkpoints, datasets, and configs strictly map 0: smoke, 1: fire.

TC8_forgetting_and_delta_formulas.details: All Delta and Catastrophic Forgetting values accurately follow mathematical definitions. Both percentage points (pp) and relative percentages (%) verified.

TC9_reproducibility.details: Independent GPU re-evaluation reproduced all reported metrics with absolute epsilon = 0.0.
